LanguageData.DepthRim.Pump.OpenWater: Cannot drain: this area is open to the ocean.
LanguageData.DepthRim.DivingAir.Label: Air supply
LanguageData.DepthRim.Settings.ParticlesTip: Marine snow, bioluminescence and seabed sediment haze. Turning this off saves frame time; water colour and ripples are unaffected.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Settings.HintsTip: Draw a pale cyan outline for your own pawns standing in murky water (enemies and wild animals never get one).
LanguageData.DepthRim.WatertightDoor.Sealed: Flooded side ({0}): colonists without a diving suit will not pass
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceShaft.TooDeep: The ocean below is {0} ({1}): too deep for an ice shaft. Diving suits only handle shallow and mid-depth water.
LanguageData.DepthRim.IceShaft.NoOcean: There is no ocean under dry land. An ice shaft has to be dug through an ice sheet or sea ice.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sub.NotAboard: Only works aboard a submarine that has cast off from the shipyard.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sub.Block.HullTooWeak: the hull is not rated for it
LanguageData.DepthRim.Route.Land: A submarine cannot travel to dry land.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Route.Unreachable: No sea route reaches that point.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Pressure.Crushing: {0} is being crushed by the water pressure. Use pressure hull walls at this depth.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Anchor.Label: Anchor
LanguageData.DepthRim.Anchor.Desc: Settle on the seafloor right next to here. The hull lands on a full map of the sea floor: the outside becomes visible and divers can leave the hull. Only possible in the shallows, or on the seabed while resting at the bottom.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Anchor.Block.NoBottom: There is no bottom to anchor on at this depth ({0}).
LanguageData.DepthRim.Anchor.Block.NotAtBottom: Bring the submarine down to the seafloor ({0}) first.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Anchor.NoSpot: There is no free stretch of seafloor next to here.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Voyage.StopDesc: Abandon the voyage and stop the submarine where it is now. The thrusters drop back to standby.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Voyage.Stalled: {0} has no working thrusters and is drifting in place. Power them back up to continue the voyage.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Voyage.ThrusterStandby: Standby (full power draw only while under way)
LanguageData.DepthRim.Torpedo.SeaOnly: Torpedoes can only travel by sea, to an ocean tile.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Torpedo.NoSeaRoute: No sea route reaches that tile.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Torpedo.OutOfRange: Out of range by sea (range {0} tiles).
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.CraftLeft: A boarding craft has left with {0} aboard.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.InspectWaiting: Waiting to leave: {0} aboard, {1} still out
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.RetreatLosses: The {0} of {1} have taken heavy losses and are falling back to their boarding craft.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.RetreatTimeout: The {0} of {1} have given up and are falling back to their boarding craft.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.RetreatSatisfied: The {0} of {1} are satisfied with the damage and are falling back to their boarding craft.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.TookAway: The boarders got away with {0} captive(s) and {1} in loot.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.CraftSunk: A boarding craft was hit and sank with {0} aboard.

LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.UnloadDesc: Let everyone and everything out of the craft.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.Occupied: Something else is at that tile.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.Arrived: The boarding craft has arrived at {0}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Boarding.NeedsMoonPool: Must be built on a moon pool.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Pirate.SubSunk: Your torpedoes have broken the pirate submarine's hull. It went down with all hands; {0} will have to find another boat.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Pirate.Boarded: Your boarding craft has cut into {0}. Its crew will fight for every compartment.\n\nClear the crew and take what you want; when your people leave, the boat will be scuttled.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Pirate.BoatSunk: A torpedo sank an attack boat of {0}.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sonar.UnknownInspect: Something is moving out there. Bring a sonar closer (within half its range) to tell what it is.
LanguageData.DepthRim.Sonar.FishInspect: A large school of fish. Harmless.
